name: Base - Three Forks depot site
objective: Start/return point. Real Perseverance sample-depot location; the crewed habitat is hypothetical.
flags: Hypothetical habitat at a real depot location

name: Wildcat Ridge
objective: Fine-grained delta-front mudstones recording quiet-water deposition; the rover found organic signals correlated with sulfates here (not evidence of life).
photoNote: ZCAM photo at Wildcat outcrop, sol 502 (historical rover imagery).
flags: Rover-documented outcrop; stop position from approximate rover parked coordinates, not a surveyed station

name: Skinner Ridge
objective: Layered sandstone with grains transported from far outside Jezero - sediment provenance and transport energy.
photoNote: Mastcam-Z 110mm frame of the layered Skinner Ridge outcrop, sol 477 (historical rover imagery).
flags: Same outcrop complex as Wildcat (~20 m apart): two distinct objectives, not two distant outcrops

name: Kodiak candidate viewpoint
objective: Observe delta-layer geometry recording lake-level change and flooding (studied remotely by the rover).
photoNote: Mastcam-Z 110mm frame of the Kodiak butte area, imaged from ~2 km away on sol 275 (historical rover imagery); the outcrop was studied remotely, never visited.
flags: Approximate target coordinate; never visited by the rover
